{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for orders with 'completed' status AND positive revenue
# This defines 'actually completed' as a transaction that was marked as completed AND generated positive revenue
actual_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Count the number of such orders
num_actual_completed = len(actual_completed)

num_actual_completed"}
